text:
marta: quick flag from the quant8 canary - reranker scores dropped on multi-pass promptset after last night's dedupe sweep. anyone else seeing this?

ezra: saw a small delta in nDCG on the dev slice, ~2.7% absolute for top-3. did we change merge thresholds?

toni: we tightened fuzzy threshold to remove more near-duplicates for storage savings. could have removed legitimate paraphrase anchors.

marta: curious if golden anchors got collapsed. the micro-rerank-gold has a few paraphrase pairs that are intentionally distinct.

kelly (label-ops): checking history. dedupe job dedupe_v2 ran at 02:08 UTC. I see golden ids gr-7891 and gr-7892 were merged by fuzzyhash_sim >= 0.88. labelers previously marked them as separate relevance judgments.

ezra: can you list the ids?

kelly (label-ops): gr-7891, gr-7892, gr-7905. I'll dump the pre-merge snapshots.

marta: thanks. @ezra can you run a quick qbench on quant8 pinned to a fork that restores those three anchors separate? command we use:
```
./ci/qbench --model quant8 --prompts micro-rerank-gold-2026-03 --out /tmp/qb-quant8.json
```

qbench-bot: queued job qbench-3810001234-quant8. link: https://ci.internal/runs/3810001234

toni: note: quant8 also switched kernel fallback ordering which can slightly affect scoring calibration. both dedupe and quant changes could play a role.

ezra: to isolate, run two jobs: (A) quant8 on current merged set, (B) quant8 on restored fork. diff will show merge impact.

qbench-bot: job A complete: nDCG@3 delta -2.6% vs baseline. job B complete: nDCG@3 delta -0.4% vs baseline.

marta: looks like the merge caused most of the hit. good repro.

kelly (label-ops): proposal: add a "preserve-paraphrase" flag for gold anchors. backfill heuristic: if two anchors in goldset have relevance_judgments disagreeing by >1 label and fuzzyhash_sim between 0.82-0.95, mark both preserve_paraphrase=true. I'll push a review.

toni: also add a unit test in dedupe that runs the golden preservation check and prevents merges when preserve_paraphrase==true.

ezra: onboarding gate idea: for any quant bring-up, run a rerank micro-gold diff and require nDCG@3 delta > -1% fails rollout. we should auto-block canary promotion.

marta: agree. I'll add the gate to the onboarding playbook and notify release team.

kelly (label-ops): I'll restore the three anchors and queue a manual review for the top 50 fuzzy merges in the rerank bank. ETA 36h for top-20, 96h for full 50.

toni: can we also snapshot the dedupe commit and goldset for traceability? ops needs that for audits.

marta: yes ops snapshot + PR for the preserve rule before unblocking rollout. hold the quant8 canary for now.

qbench-bot: note: qbench artifacts stored at s3://qbench/runs/3810001234/artifacts.tar.gz

marta: thanks all. small process change but prevents subtle regressions. we'll sync after the PR lands.

ezra: thanks – that'll save us from chasing calibration issues later.
